item.subject: science
item.stem:
In Meena's village, water from rain seeps into the ground every monsoon. Yet the water level in the village well has fallen over the last few years.
Which statement best explains why the groundwater can decrease even though water seeps into the ground?

options.A: Groundwater can never decrease, so the well must have been measured incorrectly.
options.B: Water is pumped out of the ground faster than seepage can replace it, so the groundwater level falls.
options.C: Seeped water is not groundwater because only underground lakes count as groundwater.
options.D: More seepage into the soil lowers the amount of groundwater available.
